September is National Suicide Prevention Month.

If you or someone you know is struggling, remember that help is just a call away. Utilize the 988 lifeline for support. 

Let’s raise awareness, offer support and break the stigma surrounding mental health.

https://t.co/0FuKTI9aZ4
Former First Lady Rosalynn Carter, a dedicated leader for mental health, Habitat for Humanity, and numerous noble causes, has passed at 96. My heartfelt condolences to the Carter family.

I'm pleased my amendment to the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act passed the House today! 

This amendment prohibits schools from purchasing or offering milk produced by Chinese state-owned enterprises, protects American farmers, and is a necessary step to protect the health and well-being of our children. 

We must safeguard our economy & defend our US national interests.

The inaction on our southern border by this admin is TREASON.  

Our border is the number 1 issue in America: it is a human rights, national security, & health crisis we must address. Just earlier this week, an AZ rancher spotted MS-13 members in his yard! There’s cartels, gang members, and terrorists crossing our border during this invasion.

I've co-sponsored articles of impeachment against Mayorkas & Biden for their dereliction of duty regarding border security. 

The House has already passed HR2, and the Senate needs to their job. But we also MUST ENFORCE our existing laws.

The only reason the Houthis are not on the global terrorism list is because Joe Biden removed them after Pres. Trump designated them as terrorists. 

With these attacks in the Red Sea, we're continuing to treat the symptoms  without recognizing the disease, which is the increase of  oil export out of Iran, loosening of sanctions, and not addressing China's relationship to support funding Iran’s malign activities.

We need to emphasize that this isn't an isolated incident but part of a broader coordinated effort by our adversaries and their geopolitical alignment to harm the West economically. 

Weakness invites aggression, but so does Biden’s failed foreign policies.

It was great to tour HCA Florida Lake Monroe Hospital in Sanford, the first Level II trauma center in the area. 

I enjoyed learning about the hospital’s comprehensive healthcare services, including a full service cardiovascular program. Thank you to Dr. Gary Goodman and the staff for a fantastic tour!

Happy National Nurses Day! 
Today kicks off a week dedicated to honoring the incredible contributions of nurses. Their unwavering compassion and dedication make a difference in the lives of their patients, making the world a better place. https://t.co/wrouOCQzRn

Happy National Emergency Medical Services Week! Thank you to our amazing EMS professionals in Florida’s 7th Congressional District and across the nation for your heroic service to our communities needing emergency care and assistance. https://t.co/ZWVUTsoToI

This week, I co-sponsored and voted for H.R. 1425, the No WHO Pandemic Preparedness Treaty Without Senate Approval Act, in response to the Biden-Harris administration’s secretive negotiations with the World Health Organization (WHO.) Their so-called pandemic preparedness treaty threatens American sovereignty. The Constitution matters and should not be bypassed by treating this as an executive agreement to avoid Senate approval.

This crucial legislation, introduced by @RepTiffany, would require any pandemic-related convention of the WHO that seeks to bind the United States to be ratified by the Senate as a treaty. We must protect the rights of Americans.

Early voting starts today for residents in Florida! 

I encourage everyone in Florida’s 7th Congressional District to make their voice heard and exercise their civic duty. https://t.co/GcoIK2xq84

Too many veterans face unnecessary barriers to the care and benefits they’ve rightfully earned. That’s why I proudly voted for H.R. 8371, the Senator Elizabeth Dole 21st Century Veterans Healthcare and Benefits Improvement Act, which addresses inefficiencies within the VA to improve services and expand benefits.

As a veteran, I understand these challenges firsthand. This bill includes bipartisan measures I co-sponsored, such as H.R. 3520, the Veterans Care Improvement Act, further ensuring that veterans, their families, and survivors receive the quality care, improved services, and increased benefits they deserve.

Team Mills met with the Health Care, Public Safety, and Veterans Advisory Boards to discuss legislative priorities in 2025. 

Our top priority is representing the interests of Florida’s 7th Congressional District and its community leaders. https://t.co/kiejOxCWUG

I am honored to have cosponsored and voted for H.R. 21, the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act, which ensures that babies who survive abortion attempts are given the same medical care and dignity as any other newborn. Life is sacred, and we have a moral obligation to protect these innocent children.

Team Mills, alongside local organizations and nonprofit organizations, attended the ribbon-cutting for the new Orlando Health Lake Mary community hospital. This new facility will improve healthcare services available to the community in Florida’s 7th Congressional District. https://t.co/zPB62nwTLS

As a combat veteran, I’ve once been in the position of a young Army Soldier with limited financial resources. Mismanaging funding for Soldiers’ nutrition is a betrayal of those who sacrifice to defend our freedom. For junior enlisted Soldiers, the $465 monthly flat rate for BAS can make up as much as 18% of their total pay. This misappropriation of funds directly reduces the financial support they rely on for their basic needs. The fact that nearly 50% to 80% of the $225 million collected from Soldiers’ BAS pay last year was redirected elsewhere demands an immediate investigation and swift accountability. We cannot achieve military readiness by robbing those who serve of the resources they’ve been promised.

I trust that Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth will thoroughly investigate this issue. His leadership and unwavering commitment to our warfighters is evident. Under his guidance, we have a real opportunity to address these oversights and strengthen our armed forces, retention, and lethality.

Team Mills attended the Private Business Association meeting to listen in on presentations from key healthcare providers in Florida’s 7th Congressional District. They discussed the current state and hurdles facing the healthcare system. Presenters included the Hospital Corporation of America (HCA), Advent Health, and Orlando Health.

Team Mills met with Brittany Corfman Parks, the Grassroots Engagement Coordinator for Concerned Veterans for America (CVA), to discuss the Veterans’ ACCESS Act. We are committed to ensuring our veterans receive the timely and quality healthcare services and benefits they deserve after bravely serving our nation.

Team Mills attended the Health and Wellness Women's Expo at the Brannon Center in New Smyrna, Florida, where medical professionals and businesses dedicated to supporting women's health came together. https://t.co/WQu4yMwJIb

Today, in the House of Representatives, we unanimously passed three crucial pieces of legislation supporting our veterans and service members by providing financial assistance to disabled veterans, safeguarding tuition benefits, and ensuring that insurance coverage keeps up with inflation: 
- H.R. 877, the Deliver for Veterans Act
- H.R. 983, the Montgomery GI Bill Selected Reserves Tuition Fairness Act 
- H.R. 970, the Fairness for Servicemembers and their Families Act 

One of my top priorities in Congress is honoring and serving those who courageously defended our nation to protect our freedom. We owe our veterans a debt of gratitude that can never truly be repaid, and it is our responsibility to ensure they receive the support they deserve and have earned.

As a leader in the effort on H.R. 2240, the Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety and Wellness Through Data Act, because I firmly believe in protecting our law enforcement officers who put their lives on the line every day to keep our communities safe. The rise in anti-police rhetoric and violence against officers is deeply concerning. This bill is crucial in addressing these threats by enhancing data collection on attacks against police, allowing us to better understand the challenges they face and develop strategies to improve their safety and wellness.

As a veteran myself, I want to take a moment to recognize PTSD Awareness Month. Many of our brave servicemen and women face the invisible wounds of war long after their service ends. It's vital that we raise awareness about PTSD, break the stigma surrounding mental health, and ensure that our veterans receive the support they need. 

If you or someone you know is struggling, remember that help is available. Visit https://t.co/ItxZV11CWm for resources or call 988 and push 1 for the crisis hotline. 

Let’s work together to foster a culture of understanding and compassion, ensuring that no one has to face these challenges alone. Your fight is our fight, and you are never forgotten.

Tonight I voted YES on H.R. 2483, the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act. This crucial bill will reauthorize and revise HHS programs addressing substance use disorders, overdoses, and mental health. I am glad to announce that this bill passed the House. Big thank you to my friend, @RepGuthrie for his leadership on this. 

This legislation will be a lifeline for our communities, extending much needed support for vital programs that provide for some of our most at risk populations with prevention, recovery, and resource access. 

The bill also expands resources for first responders, supports employment and transportation services for those in recovery, and establishes new HHS requirements to combat cybersecurity threats, tackle fentanyl contamination, and review critical drug scheduling.

This is a win for America.

The Rescissions Act of 2025 is a game-changer! We'd cut trillions in wasteful spending, including significant reductions to our UN contributions. It's time for other member states to pay their fair share! This bill rescinds funds for the World Health Organization and UNRWA, aligning with President @realDonaldTrump's executive orders. We're ensuring U.S. resources are used effectively and in line with American interests.

I'm proud to announce my support for the Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2026, which provides a total of $453 billion in funding to support our veterans and strengthen our national security. This bill fully funds veterans' health care, benefits, and VA programs, while investing $18 billion in military construction and family housing. We're also prioritizing the Indo-Pacific region, supporting the Guard and Reserve, and protecting our 2nd Amendment rights. Let's continue to honor our veterans and keep America safe and strong! 🇺🇸

The Democrats are LYING when they say the One Big Beautiful Bill is cutting access to essential programs like SNAP and Medicaid.

The fact is the One Big Beautiful Bio protects Medicaid and SNAP, keeping them FULLY available for everyone entitled to them. It only affects people who are fraudulently abusing the programs and should not have been on them in the first place. 

This is personal for me as I was adopted and my family benefited from programs like Medicaid and SNAP growing up. Protecting and strengthening these programs is a priority for me.
